Hi Rajiv — great to chat earlier. Appreciate the RFP excerpt; that helps a lot. High-level recap and proposed next steps below so we have a mutual action plan:

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary acceptance criteria: p95 latency under 250ms for 256-token requests, stable throughput target ~1,000 req/min, and regional capacity (US-East and US-West).
- Procurement wants clarity on commit lengths and break/fallback policies.
- Security/compliance checklist will be handled in parallel with your SecOps.

Proposed validation plan (actionable)
1) Baseline benchmark: Redwood Dedicated single-tenant trial vs CloudCo-managed inference (our internal repro of their config). We'll run identical model (open LLM you specified) across:
   - latency p50/p95, throughput, and token-cost per unit (workload: 256 tokens average, synthetic and subset of your test set)
   - run length: 72 hours continuous (capture cold starts and steady-state)
2) Feature validation: KV cache/prefix caching behavior and quantized model run to estimate cost delta.
3) Acceptance criteria: p95 <= 250ms and sustained 80% of target throughput without queuing for the peak window.
4) Timeline: kickoff within 5 business days (we can stand up trial infra in 48 hours once scope is confirmed).

Commercial/procurement notes
- Reserved capacity: typical offers are 6/12/24 month terms with commit-based pricing. We can outline a 12-month reserved node bundle and an option for burst credits if you want a smoother ramp.
- I'll pull a draft term sheet and a short benchmark spreadsheet (benchmarks.xlsx) and share by Friday.

Next steps (asks for your team)
- Confirm the model and the 1–2 representative test prompts/datasets we should use.
- Confirm whether the trial should include cross-region failover tests.
- Availability for a kickoff tech call next Tue/Wed.

I'll loop in Monica (pilot programs) and Laura (commercial lead) to help with the term/discount side.

Best,
